updates.title: In-app update notifications and release hygiene

sections.title: Update banner (PWA phase 1)
items: Persistent bottom-right banner when a newer release is on the server; polls lightweight `version.json` with cache-safe reload.
Build syncs `version.json` from `changelog.json`, verifies `dist/` on `pnpm build`, and sets Vercel no-cache headers for manifests and `index.html`.
Dismiss hides a specific server version for the session; banner returns when a newer version ships.

sections.title: Developer & supply chain
items: Cursor rules for security, exact dependency pins, Graphify-first exploration, and frontend quality guardrails.
`SECURITY.md`, Graphify skill/update scripts, and `docs/KNOWLEDGE_MAP.md`; npm deps pinned exactly via `.npmrc`.
Agent finish workflows (`add-docs`, `add-commit`, `update-test`) documented in `docs/workflows.md`.

updates.title: Multi-dashboard shell, settings drawer, and route restore

sections.title: Multi-dashboard
items: Create and switch named dashboards from the sidebar; active dashboard restored from `#dashboard?dashboardId=` in the URL hash.
Manifest persists to localStorage with validated IndexedDB backup; bootstrap waits before URL sync so bookmarked ids are not clobbered.

sections.title: Dashboard settings & footer
items: Inset bottom drawer for rename, dataset binding, viz management, and persisted `DashboardPanel` layout; blank-dashboard empty state.
Per-view footer drawer: dashboard settings or dataset info by route; live row counts when manifest metadata is missing.
URL hash wins over localStorage on reload so `#visuals`, `#dataset`, and similar routes persist.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Restore chart/table loading after worker task-queue regression: bypass queued `getMeta`/`getPage` paths, seed IDB rows from manifest previews, sample series on the main thread.
RPC timeout cancel and blank-dashboard empty-state polish.

updates.title: Filters engine, query planner, and chart filter UI

sections.title: Engine
items: Worker-side filters, query planner, and task queue (roadmap slices 1d / 1f / 1g) with tests and incremental-delivery notes in `AGENTS.md`.
Per-viz filter slicing via `vizFiltersAtomFamily`; filter and `getPage` filter tests.

sections.title: UI
items: `FilterPanel` mounted in the chart settings gear drawer (Phase 1d-ui) with embedded drawer styling and collapsible section spacing.

updates.title: System monitor, dataset storage, and table reliability

sections.title: System activity monitor
items: Sampled FPS, long tasks, heap, and RPC metrics with persisted history, export bundle, and Activity page plus floating mini panel.
Worker `System.heap` / `stats` and RPC timing; data sources registered for diagnostics.

sections.title: Dataset & storage
items: Fix empty table after fresh upload: safer `ensureDataset`, legacy key sweep on save/delete, prefix deletes without reading values.
Reconcile `dataset_meta` from rows when missing or empty `rowCount`; faster row deletion; save single JSON objects as one row.
`DatasetMeta` typing in upload components; Home sample generation via worker with improved effect handling; RPC protocol error handling.

sections.title: Tables & quality
items: Paged grid honors column visibility (`getVisibleFlatColumns`); column picker stays open on toggle with All columns + indeterminate state.
Husky pre-push hook runs `pnpm build`; expanded Vitest coverage for data service and `DataSource` warnings.

updates.title: Data engine, memory-bounded tables, and chart viewport

sections.title: Data engine & worker
items: Engine worker exposes a `Data` RPC: paged `getPage`, range, aggregated time-series, preview, and manifest helpers, backed by IndexedDB.
Typed RPC contracts (`data-contract`) and a shared `MiniGrpc` client via `getEngineRpc()` / `engineSingleton`.
Aggregations in the worker: LTTB downsampling and time-bucket methods for large series.
Expanded `docs/DATA_FLOW.md` and a design note for the memory-bounded `DataSource` (sliding-window retention for tables).

sections.title: Tables & memory
items: New `DataSource` class + `useDataSource` for virtualized tables: bounded in-memory page cache with eviction, replacing unbounded `useDatasetPage` accumulation.
`DataTable` / `SimpleTable` supports a `dataSource` mode (virtual rows + `total`) next to the existing dense `data` mode; paged mode disables client sort/filter to avoid misleading results.
Fix: long scroll no longer leaves the table stuck on a single “Loading…” column—column schema is inferred once and cached so page 0 is not re-pinned in the eviction loop.

sections.title: Charts & UI
items: `useDatasetSlice` ties chart data to the worker with viewport-aware, aggregated series loading.
Cartesian charts: pan/zoom viewport interaction hook, more robust paint and SVG mount, optional bar series renderer, extra axis margin for preview context.
Visuals page: `ChartCard` previews and a richer sample/showcase experience.

sections.title: Tests & quality
items: Broadened Vitest coverage: utils, dates, CSV, format, object-path, localStorage mock, engine aggregations, dataset storage, `DataSource` unit tests, and more.

updates.title: D3 engine: modular renderers, CartesianChart & registry

sections.title: Renderer & core
items: Split line, area, and scatter into dedicated modules (`line.ts`, `area.ts`, `scatter.ts`) with shared `shared.ts` coordinate helpers.
Move D3 curve factories to `core/curves.ts`; state and enums no longer own `curveMap`.
Rename BaseChart to CartesianChart; extract `useCartesianSvgMount` and `useCartesianChartPaint` for SVG lifecycle vs paint pipeline.
Top-level `d3-core` barrel exports core utilities only; chart code is imported by path to keep chunks explicit.
Add `charts/registry.ts` scaffold for future lazy-loaded families (donut, radial, …).
Tooltip: remove `@ts-nocheck`, normalize `x` as Date for time scales; strip debug `console.log` from d3-core entrypoints.
ChartType.BAR appears in settings as “coming soon”; axes render without series until bar renderer exists.

updates.title: Data layer, compute facade & developer tooling

sections.title: Data & compute
items: Stabilize data-engine usage for datasets and RPC-backed reads.
Compute facade (`compute/`) for WASM-backed series generation and related helpers.
Built-in sample dataset with configurable point count and default sample IDs; Home uses the same pipeline for uploads vs sample data.

sections.title: Docs & agent tooling
items: Cursor rules: project context, React/TS, Jotai, D3-core, performance guardrails.
Agent onboarding (`AGENTS.md`); repo-local skills (frontend UI, React patterns, performance, system design).
Enhance agent skills and editor configuration for dashboard work.
